title: Quantum recovery from finitely many sharp questions
description:
Preprint by Seth Douglas (seth.douglas@gmail.com) on quantitative recovery from finitely many calibrated sharp binary observables, with complete Appendix A and reproducibility materials.

Scoped licenses: the manuscript, PDF and TeX are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0). Original code and accompanying software documentation are MIT-licensed. These are separate file-specific licenses, not a choice of license for every file. See LICENSE.md and LICENSES/ in the archive. The aggregate Other (Open) category represents this mixed-license package.

Lean coverage is partial: calibrated projections imply finite-word operator-norm stability; no numbered recovery theorem is fully formalized. Language models assisted exploration and checking; the author retains responsibility for the claims.
